title: Chess.mc
body:
**Flowers** Are Change To **Chess Pieces** And This Is So U Can Play Chess With Your Friends Or Alone

**White:**
- **Dandelion** = Pawn
- **Closed/Open Eyeblossom** = Rook
- **Lilly Of The Valley** = Knight
- **Allium** = Bishop
- **Oxeye Daisy** = Queen
- **Poppy** = King
  
**Black:**
- **Red Tulip** = Pawn
- **White Tulip** = Rook
- **Cornflower** = Bishop
- **Orange Tulip** = Queen
- **Blue Orchid** = King

**Blocks:**
- **Rooted Dirt** = White Block
- **Moss Block** = Black Block

Will Maybe Change The Blocks
